correctness.rationale: For GP(n,2), n=6,7,8,9, the definition Ind_2(G) is verified to be equivalent to induced maximum degree <=1. All 2^(2n) vertex masks are searched. Independently reconstructed deterministic matchings have respectively 809,2268,6710,20799 nonempty faces and 402,1133,3351,10397 pairs. The entire oriented Hasse graphs are acyclic. Critical cells are (0:1,3:3,4:1), (0:1,5:1), (0:1,5:7), (0:1,5:4). For n=6 the signed integral 4-to-3 Morse boundary of critical mask 724 against masks [402,420,585] is exactly (0,0,0); 2-connected Hurewicz identifies this as a null attaching map. Therefore the exact integral homotopy types are 3S^3 vee S^4, S^5, 7S^5, 4S^5. Independent full face/matching/attaching reconstruction passed, not merely saved logs. Finite theorem only; no period/generalization claimed.
